contentHtml:
With the Emirates ID fine check, you will be able to know the amount of the fines you have on your record. You can obtain this information through different means, both digital and face-to-face but they are simple. Yet, we advise you to know the law related to your identification to avoid these inconveniences.

In this article, we will show you how to check fines on Emirates ID through the proper means. You will also learn how to pay the penalties, and what you can do to avoid receiving them. Let us observe:

1. What is an Emirates ID fine?

2. What types of fines can you receive on your Emirates ID?

3. How to check Emirates ID fine?

4. Where and how to pay your Emirates ID fines?

5. How can you avoid these fines?

6. Renewal and replacement of the Emirates ID

7. We help you with Emirates ID fine check

1. What is an Emirates ID fine?

The Emirates ID is the document required to carry out various activities within the United Arab Emirates. In this case, you will receive this identification after obtaining the residence visa stamp in your passport. You also can check fine on Emirates ID through this document.

Security features include fingerprint biometrics, as well as a Public Key infrastructure. Besides, this element is important so that you can sponsor your dependents or rent a home. Also, you will be able to apply for various government services and pass through the global immigration services at the airport.

However, you should know that you can receive certain fines related to this essential document for any citizen. This is why you must do the Emirates ID fine check if you have received one.

2. What types of fines can you receive on your Emirates ID?

The ID fine check helps you to know the status of the different fines that you can receive on this document. These have to do with the misuse or mishandling of the Emirates ID. Those sanctions include the following:

  • Renewal or delayed registration. You will receive this fine if you do not register or renew your card after 30 days of its expiration. In this case, the fine will be AED 200.
  • Lost or stolen card. You will receive a fine if your ID card is lost or stolen. The Abu Dhabi police fine on Emirates ID will be AED 500.
  • Damaged Emirates ID. If you have replaced, damaged, or altered your ID, you will have to pay a fine of AED 200.
  • Misuse. Illegal or improper use of this document will result in a fine of AED 2000.
  • Unauthorized use. In this case, the use of your card by another person with your consent generates a fine of AED 500.
  • False information. Providing false data or documents to get the card is prohibited by UAE law. When you do the Emirates ID fine check you will see that this is AED 1000.
  • Duplication. If you try to duplicate your document without proper authorization, you will be fined AED 2,000.

Other than those mentioned, you can also get fines for jaywalking and traffic regulation violations. You should know how check fines on Emirates ID, as these can vary according to the severity of the infraction.

3. How to check Emirates ID fine?

If you have ever wondered, how can I check my Emirates ID fine? We will show you the methods that you can use, that are similar to check your visa in UAE. You can check these fines, mainly traffic ones, through the Abu Dhabi Police website. In the same way, you can do it through the application of said Department from your smartphone.

In the first case, for the Emirates ID fine checking online, you will need to follow the steps below:

  1. Go to the Abu Dhabi Police website.
  2. Then select “utilities”.
  3. Once there, you must choose “Consult by Emirates ID” (individual fines).
  4. You will need to enter your ID number.
  5. Solve the CAPTCHA.
  6. Finally, click “Submit”.

Once you have completed all these steps, you will be able to complete the Emirates ID fine check. You will know the data of each fine, in case you have them, and the amount you must pay. However, if you do not have outstanding tickets, a message will appear indicating so.

4. Where and how to pay your Emirates ID fines?

After checking fine on Emirates ID, you can make the corresponding payment to remove the penalty. You can do the payment in various places and through different methods that we will explain below.

4.1 Sites to pay your fines

After completing the Emirates ID fine check, you must enter some of the official sites to pay them. Hence, you can pay your fines from anywhere, you just need an internet connection. The authorized sites in which you can cancel your sanctions are the following:

  • Abu Dhabi Police
  • Dubai Police
  • Ministry of Interior
  • Dubai Roads and Transport Authority
  • Sharjah Roads and Transport Authority

You should consider making the Emirates ID fine inquiry in the one that corresponds to you, to pay in the right place. In addition, with this verification, you will be able to know exactly the amount of each fine individually or as a whole. Also, once paid, you will not have to worry, because your fines will be settled.

4.2 Pay at Self-Service Kiosks

Another option you have, aside from paying online, is to go to a self-service kiosk to pay off your debt, if you wish. These kiosks allow you to perform an id card fine check and pay immediately. Thus, this method is also convenient for you to clear your fine record in the UAE.

4.3 Pay on the Abu Dhabi Police website

The Abu Dhabi Police portal allows you to do the Emirates ID fine check but also pay them. The process is quite simple; you just have to follow the next steps:

  1. Register on the web with your Emirates ID number.
  2. As on any other page, you must create a username and password.
  3. Then check fines on Emirates ID.
  4. Proceed to pay your fines with your debit or credit card.

This is the safest way to know and pay the debts of your traffic violations or ID. The Dubai police fine check Emirates ID and payment is similar to this method. Thus, you have several means by which you can keep an eye on your fines and pay them if necessary.

5. How can you avoid these fines?

You will not have to do the Emirates ID fine check if you have not committed any crime. Therefore, you should be aware of all the laws, including labor laws of the United Arab Emirates, so that you do not have to face the said fines. Next, we show you what you should keep in mind to avoid committing violations that generate fines:

  • You should always have your Emirates ID with you wherever you go within the UAE. This is because any of the authorities, especially the security forces, can request it at any place or time.
  • One of the penalties associated with the ID is lost, so try to have an authorized copy. However, it is very important that if you lose your document, you start the renewal process as soon as possible.
  • To avoid being involved in penalties, you must correctly provide all your data. Therefore, if you notice any inconsistencies when you receive your Emirates ID, please notify the relevant entity immediately.
  • By checking the Emirates ID status fine, you will be able to know if your details are up to date. If not, you must carry out the procedures for it. Also, be sure to keep an eye on the expiration date to complete the renewal process and avoid penalties.
  • Likewise, if your Emirates Card has been damaged, try to go through the process to get a new one.

Even though you know how to check individual fine on Emirates ID, it is best not to get involved in them. Therefore, following these recommendations is the best thing you can do to keep your registry clean. Also, try to keep an eye on the changes in the laws and regulations of the country to avoid these inconveniences.

6. Renewal and replacement of the Emirates ID

As we have mentioned, you can receive fines from the authorities if you do not renew or replace your ID on time. The laws in the UAE establish a grace period to renew the visa (even a grace period after visa cancellation), as well as the mentioned ID.  Although you already know how to check fine in UAE using Emirates ID, avoid them by doing these steps at the right time.

6.1 Renewing your Emirates ID

If when doing the Emirates ID fine check online Dubai, you also notice that it is expired, you must renew it. To do this, you will only have 30 days from the expiration date. Otherwise, you will have to pay the corresponding penalty for each day of delay in the renewal.

However, the authorities send a reminder to citizens to indicate that they must carry out the process. Moreover, this is one of the requirements to renew your residence visa in the United Arab Emirates. For the renewal process, you must follow the same steps that you did for the first time application.

You will also need to pay the fees and complete the process in the same emirate where you first obtained your ID.

6.2 Replacement for loss of Emirates ID

When we talk about how to check fine in Emirates ID, you may have noticed that if you lose it you will be fined. This is because the authorities can request the document at any time and not having it is a fault. Here are the steps you need to take to get a new UAE ID:

  1. Go to a police station in the corresponding emirate to report the loss or theft. The fee for this service is AED 70.
  2. Notify the Federal Identification and Citizenship Authority, which is the entity in charge of carrying out this procedure. You must do this within 7 days of the event.
  3. You will then need to go to the said authority to apply for your new ID card, the cost of which is AED 70. However, if you apply online, the cost is only AED 40.

If you have executed each of the steps, you will be able to have your new Emirates ID through the UAE Post Office.
